The <b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is one of sixteen(16) different [[Fishing|fish]] that can be caught, and either sold to the [[Lighthouse Keeper]], processed for [[cooking]], or - in it's particular case, akin to the [[Gudgeon]] - preferably used as [[{{PAGENAME}}#Fishing#Bait|bait]] while fishing for more valuable types of fish. The difficulty in catching it is relatively low, thus it's thought to be a relatively low-tier fish.

==Fishing==
The odds of catching most fish are usually affected by other fish in the same area, and what each are interested in; the more competition between fish, the less chance in catching a particular fish. To assist in this endeavor, the following is a table of this fish's preferences by the rod used, the selected bait, the location chosen to fish, the sub-area chosen to cast, and perhaps even the time of day.

===Bait===
{{PAGENAME}}s can also be utilized while [[fishing]], as one of eight(8) available baits to choose from.
*There are seven(7/16) susceptible fish; the [[Perch]], [[Sardine]], [[Tuna]], [[Pike]], [[Salmon]], [[Sturgeon]], and [[Gold crucian]].
:{{*}}Aside from the Perch and Gold Crucian, these fish are also tempted by the two lures; [[Lure with a gem|gem'd]] and [[Steel lure|steel]].
*The [[Gudgeon]] is practically identical to the {{PAGENAME}} in this regard.
:{{*}}One exception is the Tuna, which appears to prefer the {{PAGENAME}} over the Gudgeon.
*An {{PAGENAME}} (or Gudgeon) is required in order to catch the Gold Crucian.
*The Gold Crucian is generally considered the best commodity, given an {{PAGENAME}} bait.
:{{*}}Between its value and limited bait preference, no other fish compares.
:{{*}}While farming, the player will undoubtedly catch a significant quantity of Pike.
